description: This header file declares utility functions related to user and group information, such as obtaining group IDs, checking group membership, and retrieving user home directories within the 'cuttlefish' namespace.

methods.name: GroupIdFromName
methods.description: Converts a group name to its corresponding group ID.

methods.name: InGroup
methods.description: Checks whether the current user belongs to the specified group.

methods.name: SystemWideUserHome
methods.description: Returns the user's home directory as defined by the system, using getpwuid and getuid.

methods.name: CurrentUserName
methods.description: Retrieves the current logged-in user's username.
